defects.description: Cancel button border is very faint and might lack sufficient contrast against the white background for some accessibility standards
defects.location: Cancel button in Account Settings panel

top_fixes: Slightly darken the Cancel button's ghost border to ensure it meets WCAG AA contrast requirements
Consider adding a subtle focus ring or hover state definition for the inputs and buttons to improve interaction affordance

manifest.prompt: Add a primary 'Save Changes' button and a ghost-style 'Cancel' button below the fields.
